name: negative-entry-v5
source:
//@version=5
strategy("equity",initial_capital=100,default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,default_qty_value=100,margin_long=0,margin_short=0)
if bar_index==0
    strategy.entry("S",strategy.short,qty=1)
if bar_index==2
    strategy.entry("L",strategy.long)
plot(strategy.position_size)

source:

name: zero-percent-v5
source:
//@version=5
strategy("equity",initial_capital=100,default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,default_qty_value=0,margin_long=0,margin_short=0)
if bar_index==0
    strategy.entry("S",strategy.short,qty=1)
strategy.entry("L",strategy.long)
strategy.order("O",strategy.long)
plot(strategy.default_entry_qty(100))

name: price-precedence-v5
source:
//@version=5
strategy("equity",initial_capital=100,default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,default_qty_value=100,margin_long=0,margin_short=0)
if bar_index==0
    strategy.entry("S",strategy.short,qty=1)
plot(strategy.default_entry_qty(na))
plot(strategy.default_entry_qty(0))
plot(strategy.default_entry_qty(-100))
